articles.headline: Blue Jays' Max Scherzer: Announcement on future coming
articles.description: Max Scherzer said after Wednesday's game that he'll likely have something to say in the next couple days about his future.
articles.headlineJa: ブルージェイズのマックス・シャーザー、今後の進退について近く発表へ
articles.descriptionJa: マックス・シャーザーは水曜日の試合後、自身の今後について数日以内に何らかの発表をすることになりそうだと語った。
articles.body:
Max Scherzer allowed four runs and four hits in five innings in the 500th appearance -- and 491st start -- of his career Wednesday against the Orioles in Baltimore.

Just how many more he makes is now the question.

Scherzer said after the game that he'll likely have something to say in the next couple days about his future.

The 42-year-old right-hander said he hopes he can come back on short rest to pitch again Sunday in the season finale for a Blue Jays team that officially was eliminated from the postseason race after dropping Game 1 of Wednesday's doubleheader to Baltimore, 4-2 -- a year after winning the American League pennant.

Scherzer dropped to 3-9 with a 6.14 ERA.

Information from The Associated Press was used in this report.

articles.headline: Seahawks' Macdonald apologizes to Broncos' Payton for comments
articles.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.
articles.headlineJa: シーホークスのマクドナルドHC、発言をめぐりブロンコスのペイトンHCに謝罪
articles.descriptionJa: シーホークスのマイク・マクドナルドHCは水曜日、火曜日に拡散された動画内での自身の発言について、ブロンコスのショーン・ペイトンHCに電話で謝罪したと明かしました。
articles.body:
RENTON, Wash. -- Calling it a "lesson learned," Seattle Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday that his recently surfaced comments about a 2024 dispute he had with Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton were not meant for public consumption.

Macdonald, speaking to reporters a day after a clip of his comments on "In Depth With Graham Bensinger" began making the rounds on X, said he apologized to Payton

"It's something that I didn't intend for public use," Macdonald said. "But I felt like it was the most appropriate thing to reach out to Sean and really just apologize to him for having that end up be public where it wasn't meant to. It's something that they have to deal with in real time. It wasn't really on their end. So that's where you're really like, 'Crap.' But it's a lesson learned, honestly."

The dispute related to Payton's 2024 accusation that Seattle cheated while preparing to face the Broncos in that season's opener, which Macdonald revealed during his conversation with Bensinger. In one clip, Macdonald references a mistaken belief on Denver's part that the Seahawks had a "plant" at Broncos training camp that was filming the team's plays, but he said they actually saw them -- and used them in their game prep -- from what fans who had attended open practices had posted to X.

Macdonald's interview with Bensinger took place over the summer and was published on YouTube last week. Macdonald answered in the affirmative when asked Wednesday if he made his comments about the Broncos saga while speaking causally with Bensinger, before he thought the cameras were rolling.

'I've got to be better in that moment [in] understanding, look, I'm responsible for what I say really no matter the circumstance, whether you're mic'd up, whether you're not, whether you have a certain understanding," he said. "So I fell short in that moment. It stings for me, frankly, but it's something I'm definitely going to learn from and it's just a good example of we've got to take responsibility for the things that we say."

Asked if he's talked to anyone from Bensinger's show about how the clip got out, Macdonald said, "It's not important on all those details, but it got out."

Macdonald said Payton was "great" when the two spoke.

"I'll say, I respect the heck out of him and his program," Macdonald said. "He's a phenomenal football coach. It's been great to get to know him at the owners' meetings the last couple years. He was awesome. I know we're both looking forward to moving forward from it, but I really appreciate how he handled it."

The Seahawks play the Broncos in Denver in Week 6.

articles.headline: Seahawks' Darnold 'on a good track' to play vs. Commanders
articles.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is "on a good track" to play Sunday against the Commanders, coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday.
articles.headlineJa: シーホークスのダーノルド、コマンダーズ戦出場に向けて「順調な経過」
articles.descriptionJa: シーホークスのクォーターバック、サム・ダーノルドは日曜日のコマンダーズ戦出場に向けて「順調な経過をたどっている」とマイク・マクドナルドHCが水曜日に語った。
articles.body:
RENTON, Wash. -- Seattle Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday that quarterback Sam Darnold is "on a good track" to play Sunday against the Washington Commanders after missing most of the first two games with a glute injury.

Darnold is practicing Wednesday for the first time since he was hurt early in the season opener. Macdonald said he won't to take every practice rep initially, and that his workload will be ramped up as the week progresses.

Does Darnold have to be fully healthy to start?

"I don't know what fully healthy means," Macdonald said. "I think we'll make a decision at some point before Friday's over. I don't think we'd go into the weekend not knowing if he's going to play. But it's on a good track right now, assuming today goes well."

Backup Drew Lock has quarterbacked the defending champion Seahawks to a 2-0 record. Since Darnold went down on the fifth play of their 13-10 win over the New England Patriots in Week 1, Lock has completed nearly 73% of his passes with four touchdowns and zero turnovers. His Total QBR of 88.8 in the team's 31-7 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday was the third-best mark of his career.

Through two games, Lock ranks fourth among all quarterbacks in Total QBR at 85.8.

Macdonald was asked whether Lock's play allows the Seahawks to be more conservative with Darnold's return.

"If it was something where he was at risk of getting worse over the normal risk you take by taking the field, that might be part of the conversation," Macdonald said. "But really it's a function at this point of does he feel good enough to play."

Macdonald said safety Nick Emmanwori will have a "significantly higher" workload this week after playing nine snaps in his season debut in Week 2. Emmanwori missed the opener following July ankle surgery, and was also listed as having a hip injury last week.

"We'll see how the game unfolds, see how he feels," Macdonald said, "but he'll be out there a good bit."

Seattle placed right guard Anthony Bradford (knee/hip) on injured reserve Wednesday. Macdonald said he won't be sidelined long-term. In a corresponding move, the Seahawks signed safety Rodney Thomas II off their practice squad. He started the first two games while Ty Okada (hamstring) was out.

articles.headline: Sources: Extension talks stall between Knicks, Karl-Anthony Towns
articles.description: Extension talks have stagnated between the Knicks and Karl-Anthony Towns, and an agreement is considered unlikely as the team begins camp, sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：ニックスとカール＝アンソニー・タウンズの契約延長交渉が停滞
articles.descriptionJa: 情報筋がESPNに語ったところによると、ニックスとカール＝アンソニー・タウンズ間の契約延長交渉は停滞しており、チームのキャンプが始まる中で合意に至る可能性は低いと見られている。
articles.body:
Talks have stagnated between the New York Knicks and Karl-Anthony Towns on a contract extension, and an agreement is considered unlikely as the team begins training camp next week, sources told ESPN on Wednesday.

The sides have spent extensive time discussing a potential extension during the offseason, but there has been no movement lately in negotiations, sources said, as the Knicks stand to go for a repeat following their first NBA title in 53 years.

Towns, who will turn 31 in mid-November, is eligible to receive a contract extension for up to four years and $276 million, according to ESPN's Bobby Marks.

An All-Star in his two seasons in New York, Towns averaged 15.9 points, 10.6 rebounds and 4.9 assists on 55% shooting through last season's playoffs, helping the Knicks to a 16-3 mark as they defeated the San Antonio Spurs in five games in the NBA Finals.

Knicks owner James Dolan has repeatedly said he wanted to keep the Knicks out of the punitive second apron. Valuable backup center Mitchell Robinson was one of the casualties of the edict, as he signed with the Boston Celtics this offseason.

Towns is due $57 million this season and has a $61 million player option for 2027-28. As it stands, the Knicks and Towns could come to an agreement at any point this season, but it is not imminent and appears unlikely in the short-term.

The Knicks have many looming contract decisions over the next several months. Swingman Josh Hart is eligible for a contract extension as well, while Jalen Brunson and OG Anunoby will be eligible for contract extensions next offseason.

articles.headlineJa: NFLサバイバー・パワーランキング：第2週で49ersとチーフスを選ぶべき理由
articles.descriptionJa: 49ersやチーフスを含む、第3週に向けたESPNのNFLサバイバープール戦略、予想、およびピック。
articles.body:
Welcome to 2026 ESPN NFL Survivor! The rules are simple: Pick one NFL team each week to win its game. If that team wins (or ties), you advance to the next week. If that team loses, you are out. Survive all 18 weeks and you can take home a share of the $25,000 grand prize. The catch is that each team can be chosen only once.

While the rules are simple, the game theory is not. Depending on the size of your group or what platform you play on, the optimal selections could change drastically. Smaller groups will likely end well before Week 18, so optimizing win probability each week is paramount. However, the larger the group, the more you need to focus on saving strong teams for later. ESPN's game requires just one team each week, so that will be the strategic focus of this column, though we will touch on the big contests at Circa and Splash Sports.

For the second straight week, the most-selected team in ESPN Survivor lost as an 8.5-point favorite. In Week 1, the Chargers knocked out 21% of entries, falling to the Cardinals. In Week 2, it was the Buccaneers' turn, blowing a 10-point lead at home against the Cleveland Browns to eliminate 27% of the field. That wasn't the only Week 2 upset, as the Chargers lost again as 6.5-point favorites, while the Baltimore Ravens were stunned by the New Orleans Saints as 8.5-point favorites.

As a result, 68% of the original entries are already out just two weeks into the season. The Chargers are responsible for 33% of those eliminations, while the Buccaneers are responsible for another 23%.

This week, the major decision concerns the Kansas City Chiefs, who are going to be the most-selected team so far (currently 35%). Even though they are on the road, they are the largest betting favorites as they face the Miami Dolphins. Plus, they are widely available, having been used by only 9% of entries.

The second-biggest favorites are the San Francisco 49ers, who are available to only 59% of the ESPN Survivor field after hammering Miami last week. They are the only other team besides the Chiefs laying more than a touchdown, but with three of their next five games coming against the Washington Commanders, Atlanta Falcons and Ravens, they will be a staple of this column.

I was planning on making the New York Giants my top choice on Monday morning, but after injuries to Jaxson Dart and others on Monday night, they are a much more difficult click. The Green Bay Packers also were going to be one of my top picks before Sunday's games, but they looked sluggish in an overtime win against the New York Jets and picked up more injuries. The Philadelphia Eagles are a consideration if Case Keenum starts for the Chicago Bears, but they have less win equity than other teams while having strong future value, so I will pass. And as bad as the Pittsburgh Steelers offense has looked, I am not ready to fade them as a divisional home underdog against the Cincinnati Bengals.

articles.body:
Manchester United have identified a new potential replacement for left back Luke Shaw. Plus, Erling Haaland is contracted to Manchester City for another eight years, but could Bayern Munich sign him? Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Manchester United and Liverpool are interested in Crystal Palace defender Tyrick Mitchell, TEAMtalk reports. The Red Devils reportedly see the 27-year-old as an alternative to Newcastle's Lewis Hall as they continue plans to identify a long-term successor to Luke Shaw. Mitchell entered the final 12 months of his contract in the summer, and it is said that Chelsea are also monitoring his situation, attracted to the opportunity of landing him on a free transfer.

- Bayern Munich have emerged as suitors for Manchester City striker Erling Haaland, according to TEAMtalk. The Bundesliga side are believed to see the 26-year-old as a potential future replacement for Harry Kane, who they want to remain at the Allianz Arena for a further two years before assessing whether a move for Haaland is possible. Meanwhile, TEAMtalk reports that Vincent Kompany's side are also keen on Nottingham Forest attacking midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White, and could be contenders for his signature next summer amid plans to add him to their squad with England compatriot Kane.

- Chelsea and Manchester City are exploring a move for AC Milan forward Francesco Camarda, according to TEAMtalk. The Blues are said to have tracked the 19-year-old for some time, and they are monitoring whether an opportunity to land him could arise due to a lack of minutes for the Rossoneri since returning from his loan spell at Lecce. Camarda scored one goal in 21 Serie A appearances last season.

- Napoli are struggling to make progress in talks with the representatives of midfielder Kevin De Bruyne over a new contract, transfer journalist Nicolo Schira reports. Discussions have reportedly stalled with the 35-year-old, who arrived at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on a two-year deal in the summer of 2025, and it is now said that they are "on the verge" of parting ways next summer. De Bruyne was previously linked with clubs in Major League Soccer and the Saudi Pro League before deciding to join Gli Azzurri.

- On-loan Aston Villa winger Alejandro Garnacho is attracting interest from clubs in LaLiga, the Daily Mail reports. The 22-year-old is believed to be on the radar of several clubs in Spain amid struggles to earn a place in Unai Emery's side, with 32 minutes of action in the Premier League spread across three substitute appearances. He is on loan from Chelsea, but any potential permanent move at Villa Park would require conditions to be met, which would see a £43 million proposed deal become official.

articles.headline: Inside the basketball of 'One Tree Hill' 23 years later
articles.description: In honor of 23 years since "One Tree Hill" premiered, James Lafferty & Co. take us inside the basketball heart of the cult classic TV show.
articles.headlineJa: 23年後の『One Tree Hill』におけるバスケットボールの舞台裏
articles.descriptionJa: 『One Tree Hill』の放送開始から23年を記念し、ジェームズ・ラファティらがこのカルト的人気ドラマの核心であるバスケットボールの裏側を明かす。
articles.body:
WILMINGTON, N.C. -- "Are you here for the big game?" my new friend behind the car rental counter asked shortly after I touched down in Michael Jordan's hometown.

"People are saying you need to be in line by 7 a.m. if you want a chance at a decent seat," she exclaimed before I could answer.

To my surprise, my big game and her big game were one and the same: the "Hey 23" basketball game celebrating 23 years since the hit television show "One Tree Hill" first aired.

Pausing to look around Wilmington International Airport, it appeared nearly everyone arriving in town had the same purpose. Couples, families and groups of friends of all ages -- all donning black, white and royal blue, and not of the Duke Blue Devils variety.

I had counted at least seven combined "Scott" jerseys and two red Quentin Fields-inspired capes before a handmade "You can't kill Dan Scott" sign diverted my attention.

Then the same cheerful voice snapped me back into focus.

"Your car is ready. Just head to spot No. 23! See you tomorrow!"

Unclear whether my rental assignment was intentional or an omen, I grabbed the keys and stepped out into the North Carolina heat.

If a 23rd anniversary feels arbitrary, you're clearly not a "One Tree Hill" fan.

OTH's premise centered around a pair of half-brothers, Lucas (played by Chad Michael Murray) and Nathan Scott (played by James Lafferty) who starred on their high school basketball team in the fictional North Carolina small town of Tree Hill.

The beloved teen drama -- and in my entirely unbiased opinion, the most slept-on basketball show of our generation -- followed Nathan Scott, aka No. 23 and his journey from winning a state championship in high school to being recruited by Duke until his college plans were derailed by his involvement in a point-shaving scheme. Scott eventually went on to win a national title at Maryland before suffering a spinal injury the night before the NBA draft. He then mounted a comeback that started with SlamBall, then saw him play in the D-League and finally become the starting point guard for the then-Charlotte Bobcats.

In the 2000s, Nathan's evolution from a brash high school standout to a selfless NBA star left an indelible mark on a generation of fans. The Ravens never existed -- there was no Tree Hill High and no state championship banner. But for the people who watched the scripted show and the actors who portrayed the characters, the basketball was real. In the years since its historic nine-season run from 2003 to '12, it has amassed a cult following of a magnitude I couldn't quite grasp until setting foot where the show was filmed.

'Hey 23'

On Sept. 19, in front of nearly 5,000 fans at UNC Wilmington's Trask Coliseum, the show's stars, including Lafferty, Murray, Antwon Tanner, Robbie Jones, Bryan Greenberg and Stephen Colletti took the court together again.

articles.description: Manchester United great Eric Cantona has said he would never have joined the club had current co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe been in charge.
articles.headlineJa: エリック・カントナ氏、90年代にジム・ラトクリフ氏が経営権を握っていたらマンUに「加入していなかった」
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのレジェンドであるエリック・カントナ氏は、現在の共同オーナーであるジム・ラトクリフ卿が当時チームを率いていたならば、決してクラブに加入することはなかっただろうと語りました。
articles.body:
Manchester United great Eric Cantona has said he would never have joined the club had current co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe been in charge.

Ratcliffe has courted more controversy this week, saying in a BBC interview that the United Kingdom is in decline because "nobody's tough enough to deal with the immigration problem."

France forward Cantona has previously been named by Ratcliffe as his favourite United player.

But when United fan Pete Boyle, on his TikTok channel, asked Cantona if he would have signed for the club under Ratcliffe, he replied: "No, Of course not.

"You know what I think about all of this, with this kind of politics and I cannot understand that someone like this can say something like this when he's one of the owners of the club.

"Football is a very popular sport. Football is made -- all the greatest players come from different waves of immigration. Everywhere, in France, in England, everywhere.

Cantona moved to Old Trafford in 1992 from rivals Leeds and helped the club win four Premier League titles in five seasons.

articles.headline: Man United transfer strategy 'financial sustainable' as losses increase - CEO
articles.description: Manchester United's summer transfer strategy had "financial sustainability in mind," according to CEO Omar Berrada, after reporting a increased financial losses.
articles.headlineJa: 赤字拡大もマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの移籍戦略は「財政的に持続可能」とCEOが主張
articles.descriptionJa: 赤字の拡大が報告されたのを受け、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのオマル・ベラダCEOは、今夏の移籍戦略は「財政的な持続可能性を念頭に置いたもの」だったと述べた。

articles.headline: Sources: Mikel Arteta agrees a new long-term contract extension with Arsenal
articles.description: Arsenal are expected to announce Mikel Arteta has signed a new long-term contract after the 44-year-old agreed terms to stay on as manager, sources have told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：ミケル・アルテタがアーセナルと長期の契約延長に合意
articles.descriptionJa: ESPNが情報筋から得た情報によると、44歳のミケル・アルテタ監督が留任の条件に合意したため、アーセナルは彼との新たな長期契約締結を近く発表する見込み。

articles.headline: Liverpool close to appointing Julian Ward as sporting director - sources
articles.description: Liverpool are closing in on the appointment of Julian Ward as the club's new sporting director, sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: リヴァプール、ジュリアン・ウォードのスポーツディレクター就任決定に近づく＝情報筋
articles.descriptionJa: 情報筋がESPNに語ったところによると、リヴァプールはクラブの新しいスポーツディレクターとしてジュリアン・ウォード氏を任命する決定に近づいています。

articles.headline: Former Mexico coach Aguirre takes over at struggling Valencia
articles.description: LaLiga side Valencia have appointed former Mexico coach Javier Aguirre on an initial deal until the end of the season.
articles.headlineJa: 低迷するバレンシア、元メキシコ代表監督アギーレ氏が就任
articles.descriptionJa: ラ・リーガのバレンシアは、元メキシコ代表監督のハビエル・アギーレ氏と今季終了までの契約を結び、新監督に任命しました。
